Container.Name: WebMiniDisc
Container.Overview: Self-hosted Web MiniDisc Pro. Serves the app over HTTPS on port 8474 with a self-signed certificate. Open the WebUI link and accept the certificate warning once. WebUSB only works on an HTTPS page, and the MiniDisc must be plugged into the computer running the browser (Chrome, Edge, or Brave), not into the server. This container runs Downtify on 127.0.0.1:8000 (not published) and a MiniDisc metadata library on 127.0.0.1:8001 (not published). The browser uses /downtify/ and /md-library/ on this app. The embedded Downtify has private settings, defaults to FLAC, and writes into the shared music folder. It does not replace the separate Downtify app.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: HTTPS port for Web MiniDisc Pro

Config.Name: Music
Config.Description: Shared music folder. The embedded Downtify saves here, alongside files from the separate Downtify app.

Config.Name: Embedded Downtify Data
Config.Description: Private settings and database for the Downtify inside Web MiniDisc. Do not point this at the other Downtify app's appdata.

Config.Name: Disc Library Data
Config.Description: SQLite database and saved WAV files for album matches and disc recognition.

Config.Name: Downtify Upstream
Config.Description: Downtify base URL reachable from this container. Leave this as http://127.0.0.1:8000 to use the embedded copy.

Config.Name: MiniDisc Library Upstream
Config.Description: MiniDisc metadata service base URL. Leave this as http://127.0.0.1:8001 to use the embedded copy.
